sources.supported_claim: Death changes movement/lifecycle/wave/buffs/graveyard/reactions, does not take pending cast, remove active casts, or remove follow areas.
Withdrawal takes pending and cancels active cast/follow areas; released projectile/GroundFixed remain.
Earlier piercing hits followed by empty expiry interval remove runtime without a terminal impact; finite settlement cannot use step-terminal callback alone.
Pending CastEnd takes pending, invokes then updates recovery/resonance; dead caster invocation can return without a cast.
Death movement interruption changes movement/action state only; it does not share withdrawal cast cleanup.
Current cast removal/gates/deferred state is not an independent finite-delivery settlement authority.

findings.finding: withdraw/death cleanup grouping is false for death
findings.resolution: Preserve each actual cause. Never invoke withdrawal cleanup on death merely to simplify action observation; dead pending invocation is a failed/no-release observation if it cannot invoke, with existing resource/recovery behavior preserved. Allow-dead OnDeath remains qualified separately.

findings.finding: Piercing runtime may end without old damage-gate terminal callback
findings.resolution: Observe actual removal for finite delivery completion without synthesizing hit/gate success or altering deferred-step gameplay. A still deferred control decision must not be presented as FlowFinished.

limitations: Static source verification. New causal/action behavior and regressions remain unimplemented and require actual GEX tests.
